init.title: Librus – SMS gateway & polling
init.description:
Settings are stored in Home Assistant (not in the integration files), so updating the integration won't overwrite them.

Placeholders available in URLs and message text: `%tekst%` (rendered SMS text – URL only), `%uczen%` (student), `%typ%`, `%przedmiot%` (subject), `%ocena%` (grade), `%kategoria%`, `%nauczyciel%` (teacher), `%data%`, `%waga%` (weight), `%komentarz%` (teacher's comment), `%srednia%` (weighted subject average after this grade), `%tresc%` (note text), `%rodzaj%` (note kind). Values in URLs are URL-encoded automatically.

Example: `https://sms.example.pl/smsgateway/48600000000?text=%tekst%`

Test: tick “Send a test SMS/push” at the bottom and click Submit – you will see the result. Later you can also use the “Test powiadomien – ocena/uwaga” buttons on the Librus device.

Each line in the URL fields is a separate host/number – the SMS is sent to all of them.

data.scan_interval: Outside school hours: poll Librus every (minutes)
data.sms_enabled: Send SMS via my own gateway (master switch)
data.sms_verify_ssl: Verify gateway SSL certificate (disable for self-signed)
data.sms_url_oceny: Gateway URLs – new grade (one per line)
data.sms_url_uwagi: Gateway URLs – new behaviour note (one per line)
data.push_notify: Push to phone – notify services (one per line)
data.sms_headers: HTTP headers (one per line, Name: value)
data.wyslij_test: 🧪 Send a test SMS/push when I click Submit
data.scan_interval_szkola: During school hours: poll Librus every (minutes)

data_description.scan_interval: Default 120 min (after school, evenings, weekends). The first morning poll is automatically aligned to the start of school hours.
data_description.sms_enabled: When off, the integration does NOT call the gateway URLs (they stay saved) but still fires HA events (librus_apix_nowa_ocena, librus_apix_nowa_uwaga) and push.
data_description.sms_url_oceny: Empty = don't send SMS for grades.
data_description.sms_url_uwagi: Empty = don't send SMS for notes.
data_description.sms_method: GET – parameters in the URL (default). POST – parameters from the ?a=b&c=d part of the URL are sent in the body (form-urlencoded). POST JSON – parameters in the body as JSON.
data_description.push_notify: HA notify service name, e.g. mobile_app_my_iphone (or notify.mobile_app_my_iphone) – see Developer tools → Actions. One phone per line. Push is sent regardless of the SMS switch; empty = no push.
data_description.sms_headers: Added to every gateway request, e.g. `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN` or `X-Api-Key: abc123`. Basic auth (e.g. Twilio) can also go in the URL: https://SID:TOKEN@api.twilio.com/…
data_description.wyslij_test: Sends a test “new grade” (5 in “Test (przedmiot)”) through the URLs and push services above, then shows the result. Not saved.
data_description.scan_interval_szkola: Default 55 min (45-min lesson + break). Minimum 15 min – polling too often may get the Librus account blocked.
data_description.szkola_od: Start of the “at school” window (e.g. 07:00). Set from ≥ to in order to disable the window and always use the outside-school interval.

test.title: Test result
test.description:
**SMS:** sent {sms_ok} of {sms_all} URLs
**Push:** sent {push_ok} of {push_all} services
{blad}

Details (gateway response, errors) are in the logs: Settings → System → Logs, filter “librus”.

Click **Submit** to save the settings (or close the dialog to discard).

error.sms_url_invalid: One of the URLs is invalid – each must start with http:// or https:// and contain a host.
error.sms_url_required: SMS sending is enabled but no gateway URL was provided.
error.sms_headers_invalid: One of the headers is malformed – each line must look like `Name: value`.

wyslij_sms.name: Send SMS via gateway
wyslij_sms.description: Sends an SMS through the gateway configured in the integration options (or to the URL given in the url field). Useful for tests and custom automations.

typ.name: Type
typ.description: Which URL/text set to use: ocena (grade) or uwaga (note).

uczen.name: Student
uczen.description: Placeholder %uczen%. Defaults to the student's name from Librus.

tekst.name: Rendered SMS text
tekst.description: If given, replaces the text template from options (placeholder %tekst%).

url.name: Gateway URL (optional)
url.description: If given, sends to this URL (or URLs – one per line) instead of the ones from the integration options.

push.name: Also push
push.description: Also send push via the notify services from the integration options.

options.post_json: POST JSON (parameters in body as JSON)
